thread:
nora (sec-eng): Quick kickoff: vendor pen-test next Tue. Need to finalize RBAC change, KMS access model, audit export flow, and retest booking. Can we triage now?
ben (infra): I want to avoid giving assessors long-lived CMK perms. Suggest a KMS-proxy lambda that only exposes Decrypt for session keys. Ephemeral creds from STS.
kai (eng-sre): Agree. Proxy TTL = 2h by default, extendable with ops approval. We can tag requests with pt:session to make logs filterable.
lina (ops): For logs: will snapshot CloudTrail + VPC flow to a locked S3 prefix, generate presigned GETs for assessors. Rotate links every 12h. Upload process example:```bash
aws s3 cp /tmp/cloudtrail-2026-04-01.json s3://redwood-pt-readroom/2026-04-01/ --acl private
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-readroom/2026-04-01/cloudtrail-2026-04-01.json --expires-in 43200
```
mira (legal): NDA must be in place before access. Also require PII redaction step and a signed data handling attestation for the vendor. Retention: 90 days post-engagement unless exceptions applied.
nora (sec-eng): Good. RBAC: we need a short-lived IAM role that maps to vendor principals with minimal permissions: read-only on S3 prefix, read-only CloudWatch logs, and the proxy invoke. Who drafts the IAM policy?
enkai (eng-sre): I'll draft the IAM policy. Example inline condition to limit by tag: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-readroom/*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:RequestTag/pt:session":"true"}}}]}
```
ben (infra): For KMS, policy on the CMK should deny direct use by the vendor account and only allow the proxy role. We'll keep a separate staging CMK for reproduce.
lina (ops): Scheduling: propose main test windows Apr 12 10:00-14:00 PT and Apr 14 13:00-17:00 PT. Dry-run Apr 11 (staging only) 11:00-12:00 PT. Any conflicts?
kai (eng-sre): Works for oncall. I'll attach oncall rota and add runbook link to the invites.
mira (legal): Also document chain-of-custody for logs: who downloaded what and when. Presigned URLs should be logged.
nora (sec-eng): Runbook checklist items: 1) NDA verified, 2) presigned URLs created, 3) KMS-proxy deployed and smoke-tested, 4) SIEM pt:session filters in place, 5) retest windows confirmed. Volunteers?
ben (infra): I'll own KMS proxy and smoke test.
kai (eng-sre): IAM/RBAC PR is mine. Will push by EOD and request review from aziz and nora.
lina (ops): I'll own presigned ops flow + calendar invites + confirm NDA gate with mira.
mira (legal): I'll confirm vendor NDAs and data attestation by EOD tomorrow.
pt-bot: Ticket PT-4599 created: pen-test access orchestration. Assigned: kai, ben, lina.
nora (sec-eng): Cool. One more ask: enable CloudTrail insights for the readroom buckets during the window, and export key usage logs to the SIEM. We should tag all related alerts with pt:id=4599.
kai (eng-sre): Adding pt:id tagging to proxy and SIEM rule: pt:id = "PT-4599". Will add query snippets in runbook.
ben (infra): I'll ensure staging CMK exists and key policy separates vendor. Also will add condition to proxy to limit Decrypt to objects with pt:session tag.
nora (sec-eng): Thanks. Let's do a 10m sync tomorrow after PR + runbook drafts are in. If blockers, reply here. :wave:
